subject: Request: interim per-token banding for hosted API commit
messages:
From: Ellie Carter <ellie@acme-analytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-17T15:02:00Z
Subject: Pricing: per-token banding for hosted API commit

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Acme liked the latency numbers. We have a procurement question before we can move to contracting: our initial Q4 plan is a $40k/mo committed spend for 3 months with a fairly steep ramp in Q1.

Current rate card gives us ~1.0c/token for hosted API at our volume, but given the pilot nature we were hoping Redwood could do an interim band at 0.6c/token for the first quarter (or a blended rate across Q4).

Questions from procurement:
- Is a quarter-long pilot with a blended rate something you can approve or does it need a formal custom pricing sign-off?
- Can we lock that band for three months and then re-evaluate against actual usage?
- Any minimum commitment or cancellation windows we should expect?

Attaching our MAPP and a rough forecast. Happy to hop on a short call if that helps move things faster.

Thanks,
Ellie

--
Ellie Carter

Acme Analytics

Subject: Re: Pricing: per-token banding for hosted API commit

Karthik / Marissa — looping you in. Acme is asking for a short pilot: $40k/mo x 3 months with a blended 0.6c/token for that window. They expect to ramp in Q1. Procurement explicitly asked whether this can be handled as an interim band (pilot) or we need a custom Exception path.

Quick context: Acme is an active prospect in Northeast verticals, likely to expand if the pilot meets latency/cost targets. Margin hit at 0.6c is material but the volume profile shows a fast ramp.

Can we:
- Approve an interim band for a single quarter under a controlled pilot (tracking to HubSpot deal ACME-2026-018)?
- Require a performance escalator tied to usage thresholds?

If this needs escalated sign-off, I can draft the internal paper and route.

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellie Carter <ellie@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-17T18:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Pricing: per-token banding for hosted API commit

Mina — thanks for the heads up and the forecast. A few points from margin / pricing ops:

- 0.6c/token is below our Standard Hosted floor for that commit band. We can consider an interim band only if we: (a) put a firm 3-month term, (b) require a minimum $40k/mo non-refundable portion, and (c) include a 15% usage-based escalator if monthly usage exceeds forecast by 40%.
- Alternative: offer a blended two-tier approach — 0.75c/token for Q4 (pilot) with a predetermined reprice in January to your standard matched band or negotiated custom band. This preserves margin while giving them a clear runway.
- I attached a proposed_rate_grid.csv with a couple of grid options (interim-band, blended).

Operational asks if we proceed: Revenue Ops must tag the deal with an "interim-band" special pricing code and CS needs an onboarding playbook that limits KV cache retention to standard TTLs to avoid storage-cost surprises.

If Marissa is comfortable, I can route to Finance for a quick margin check and generate the internal approval template.

-Karthik

Attachments:
- proposed_rate_grid.csv (CSV)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellie Carter <ellie@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Pricing: per-token banding for hosted API commit

Mina / Karthik — I support moving forward with a controlled pilot. My asks:

1) Use the blended two-tier option (0.75c for Q4, automatic re-eval Jan 15).
2) Add a clause that the pilot rate is valid only if Acme signs the DocuSign within 7 business days and sets up billing on our billed-in-advance cadence.
3) No SLA credits or retroactive discounts in the pilot; any exceptions require Finance + Legal approval.

Karthik — please run the quick margin check and confirm we can absorb the 0.75c blended path with the non-refundable clause. Finance ops — expedite so Mina can give the customer a concrete DocuSign URL.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, East
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T18:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Pricing: per-token banding for hosted API commit

Hi Ellie — thanks for the patience. Internal approvals are in place for a controlled pilot. Summary of proposed terms:

- Pilot term: 3 months (Q4) starting on the effective date in DocuSign.
- Commit: $40,000/month (non-refundable portion: $35,000/mo).
- Pilot rate: blended 0.75c/token for Q4.
- Re-eval: automatic pricing review on 2027-01-15 with either standard rate-card or a negotiated custom band based on actual usage.
- Escalator: if monthly usage > forecast by 40%, a 15% price escalator applies for subsequent months.
- Operational limits: standard KV cache TTLs for the pilot; additional storage/retention to be scoped separately.

Next steps: I have created the DocuSign packet (link below). If procurement signs within 7 business days we can enable the pilot the following Monday.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/Acme-ACME-2026-018
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/ACME-2026-018

Ellie — can you confirm procurement is OK with the non-refundable component and the re-eval date? Once you confirm, I'll send the DocuSign invite to the procurement inbox.

Best,
Mina
